purpose: Reconstruct the selected vehicle's recorded local calendar day, with session totals, chronological events and explicit source availability.
primaryGoal: Understand what happened, when and from which recorded source; search/filter the complete day, inspect exact transitions and open related drive or charge records without inventing missing state.

dataSources.sourceOwner: internal\api\daylog\handler.go; internal\api\daylog\events.go; internal\database\daylog repository (repository queries not inspected)
dataSources.behavior: Disabled until a positive integer vehicle and nonempty date/timezone exist. Query key includes vehicle, calendar date, timezone and sorted layer identities. Forwards AbortSignal to every request. Operational query policy; no page polling configured. Sequentially accumulates pages against first.total_events; preserves first-page metadata.
dataSources.trust: Backend read failures return fatal HTTP errors rather than independent successful source payloads. Source rows distinguish ok/empty/unavailable. Signal and gear input caps are separate from result pagination and set truncated. Signal transitions are not continuously reconstructed state.
dataSources.units: Summary and known payload fields are meters, seconds and watt-hours; SOC remains percent. SI is retained in the hook/cache and converted in presentation.

dataSources.endpoint: Inherited useVehicles dependency, not independently endpoint-audited in this item
dataSources.behavior: Selected vehicle resolves URL, persisted workspace store and first known vehicle. Timezone resolves selected vehicle setting then user override/browser fallback; UTC vehicle timezone currently falls back to user timezone. Preserve existing resolution, not a new timezone preference engine.
Fatal errors only replace sections when no retained payload exists. Background failure/offline retention flows to StaleRefreshWarning, keeping existing event/source/summary data.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Category-barrel layout with scope-first PageActions, query freshness metadata, localized title/subtitle, timezone description, copy-link overflow and independent children; page does not pass shell loading/error/empty gates.

components.name: DayLogControls
components.contract: date/timezone/onDateChange; shared Button/Input; previous/next/today and native date input; input describes daylog-timezone.

components.name: DayLogOperationalSummary / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Six typed source metrics adapted by useOperationalMetrics; source-specific formatter callbacks preserve distance/duration/energy conventions. Compact brief exposes scope, exact exclusive UTC bounds, provenance, status and retained missing values. OperationalBrief internals not inspected.

components.name: DayLogTimeline
components.contract: GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, Code, Badge, Input, Button, EmptyState, QueryError, Skeleton; TanStack virtualizer for complete recorded event list. Domain-owned categorization, titles, transitions and structured payload rendering. Native Link retains deep-link semantics.

components.name: DayLogSources / Table
components.contract: Always-mounted GlassPanel; semantic row headings; localized statuses/reasons; shared Table owns horizontal containment. Table supports embedded variant but this caller uses standalone.

components.name: StaleRefreshWarning / FadeIn
components.contract: Polite retained-data notice with offline-specific message and retry; reduced-motion-aware entrance honoring shared preference, not ambient animation.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local DetailLine reuses Text/Code and represents event-specific payload semantics. Skeleton/error/empty branches repeat across Sources and Timeline but use existing feedback primitives; this is not evidence for a new competing state component.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep domain transformation local; only extract a broader composite after two independent production consumers demonstrate the same typed behavior.

sourceBehavior: DayLogControls.tsx:30-63 wraps and uses minmax(0,1fr), full-width below xl and 44px controls below sm; 36px controls at sm and above.
DayLogTimeline.tsx:170-205 wraps search/actions/category chips. Category badge is hidden below sm but expanded details retain the category.
DayLogTimeline.tsx:228 provides a 55vh list with min-h-80 and its own scroll container; large days are virtualized, not sliced away.
Table.tsx:24-28 contains source-table horizontal scroll rather than guaranteeing all columns fit.
PageLayout.tsx:11 uses full width, min-w-0 and allocated-container composition.

issues.detail: Expanded content keeps a fixed 4.75rem left indent inside a p-6 panel, while titles/details are truncated. At 320px this leaves little usable payload width; event/category content is recoverable only by expansion. Actual clipping is unverified.
issues.fix: Reflow expanded details to full width on narrow containers; retain every source/id/layer/timestamp/payload line and test long values at 320px and 200% text.

sourceStrengths: Controls have localized names; date input references the timezone description.
Category filters have aria-pressed and a named group; expansion has aria-expanded and localized action names.
Loading sections use role=status; Sources uses a named semantic Table and scope=row.
Icons in colored event dots are aria-hidden; meaningful event type/state remains textual.
Shared FadeIn source honors reduced motion; no browser acceptance claimed.

issues.rule: MDC-040 complete keyboard and screen-reader reachability
issues.detail: Virtualized role=list exposes only mounted rows. No focusable list container, aria-setsize/aria-posinset, focus-retention policy or nonvirtualized accessible alternative is present in this feature source. Off-screen event keyboard reachability and focus when scrolling require runtime verification.
issues.fix: Add a source-order-preserving accessible traversal strategy and stable focus policy without dropping virtualization or event records; exercise Tab, scrolling, expansion and screen-reader list announcements on long days.

issues.detail: Every collapsed row has the same 'Show details' accessible name and no aria-controls relationship; row context may be difficult to recover when many identical controls are encountered.
issues.fix: Include localized event/time context in the expansion name and associate a stable details id while retaining current labels, expanded state and actions.

states.initialLoading: Summary passes loading to OperationalBrief; Timeline/Sources render named Skeleton status regions independently (DayLogPage.tsx:65,85-110).
states.empty: Summary distinguishes no sessions from missing measurements and points to drives; Timeline explains quiet/no telemetry and links live monitor; Sources empty points to charging. Filtered-empty restores all filters. Sections remain mounted.
states.fatalError: state.fatalError is passed to three independently recoverable QueryError surfaces sharing refetch; PageLayout is not gated behind raw query error.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: state.data survives; StaleRefreshWarning renders polite recovery with refresh disabled while refreshing; summary labels retained history when status is stale.
states.offline: Shared retained-data warning describes refresh blocked/offline. With no retained data, page isPending uses skeletons and no explicit initial offline explanation is authored in the feature.
states.partial: Unavailable source rows and summary status are explicit; truncated warning appears above timeline. No partial option is passed to useDataState for cap loss.
states.unknown: Summary rawValue uses null rather than zero; unknown event types and scalar tokens survive. Sources do not fabricate user presence. Structured payload readers accept only finite numbers and valid scalar types.

issues.rule: MDC-026 incomplete paging must not claim complete history
issues.detail: An empty later page or guard exit can return events shorter than first.total_events while retaining first.truncated=false. Timeline uses loaded array length as its total and says the complete day is still loaded. This is a source-level latent trust risk; no failing server response was exercised.
issues.fix: Make paging shortfall explicit through an existing data-trust contract or actionable failure retaining usable records; do not confuse paging incompleteness with backend signal-cap truncation or silently adjust total_events.

issues.detail: Summary readiness checks unavailable sources but not data.truncated; the Timeline discloses cap loss while the summary may still say 'Recorded day summary'. Summary session totals are not thereby proven wrong, but event completeness is not reflected in screenshot-level context.
issues.fix: Retain valid session totals and their basis; surface recorded-history cap loss in contextual provenance/status without treating missing transitions as measured zero.

visualIssues.detail: Hour rules at 276/280, row border at 303 and expanded surface at 349 use white with fixed alpha. These are low-opacity decoration, not full-white body text, but bypass theme-aware border/surface ownership.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing border-subtle and neutral surface tokens; keep timeline grouping and expanded hierarchy across light/dark/custom/forced-color modes.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 semantic hue without saturation escalation
visualIssues.detail: DAY_LOG_ACCENT defines a private hex palette; Timeline.tsx:310 repeats these bright hues on every circular icon with an alpha backdrop. This is semantic event coding, not confirmed neon or glow, but palette saturation/theme suitability is uncontrolled by shared tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Map existing event semantics to restrained shared severity/neutral roles, retaining textual event labels and safety meaning; do not consume legacy neon/glow token variants as a modernization shortcut.

visualIssues.detail: Standalone Table defaults to its own framed surface inside a p-6 GlassPanel; the existing primitive supports embedded. This adds avoidable nested surface/border emphasis.
visualIssues.fix: Evaluate Table variant='embedded' while preserving every row, row heading, status/reason and horizontal containment.

architectureIssues.rule: Search affordance must match actual scope
architectureIssues.detail: Search placeholder advertises 'Search time' at 174, but matching uses localized generic title plus eventKeywords. Neither formatted timestamp nor event.ts is included; component-specific rendered titles may also differ from the generic search title.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse the actual row description and timezone clock representation in client-side search while preserving raw source/state matching and unchanged server totals.

architectureIssues.detail: formatTimeSeconds and hourKeyInTz hardcode en-GB and hour-only separators. A fall-back DST day repeats a local hour; rows retain exact UTC timestamp only in expanded details, so adjacent repeated hours can appear indistinguishable. API computes 23/25-hour bounds correctly in handler.go:143-144.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve seconds, 24-hour intent and server chronological order; provide timezone/offset disambiguation for repeated hours and use an existing locale policy if compatible rather than a competing formatter.

priority.first: Resolve incomplete-fetch trust and virtualized keyboard reachability before cosmetic changes.
priority.then: Remove fixed-white/nested framing/private accent decoration and verify narrow-width detail access.
priority.preserve: Do not replace the independent local calendar day with global rolling range or merge this domain timeline with unrelated activity feeds.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing theme-aware neutral/severity contract adoption; no new shared component justified

propsVariantsStates.table: Existing Table.variant='embedded'; not a new API

requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: Page adoption and shared-theme acceptance only; do not create a competing palette or edit shared files in a page item.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Complete-day fetch integrity and retained-data contract
requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: Integration-owned hook hardening; not a new query-state implementation.

competingImplementations.detail: Domain clock/hour formatting and private accent palette overlap shared formatting/theme responsibilities, but contain specialist chronology requirements. Legacy DayLogSummary.tsx exists in the directory but is not imported by the audited page and was not semantically audited.
competingImplementations.fix: Retain specialist day/seconds/DST behavior while adopting existing compatible shared contracts. Do not transplant the unmounted summary or invent another timeline library.

preservation.sourceHashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of exact DayLogPage.tsx bytes at audit read and final verification
preservation.sectionEvidence: DayLogPage.tsx:85,98,110; two feature GlassPanel sections and one OperationalBrief summary; zero charts
actions: Empty-timeline Open live telemetry with vehicle_id
dataBehavior: URL date remains YYYY-MM-DD; setDate preserves other query parameters. Invalid date falls back to today in resolved vehicle timezone.

Workspace scope at /day-log is range=false, vehicle=true (workspaceScope.ts:22-77,159-172). Local calendar day is independent business scope, not an accidental duplicate global range selector; preserve header vehicle ownership and do not introduce useRangeState or a second vehicle picker.
Native date input has max=today while Next day currently allows stepping beyond today; do not silently change this existing asymmetry without an explicit behavior decision.
Server resolves local midnight and exclusive next local midnight using AddDate; DST days are not assumed to be 86400 seconds.
Omitted layers means all optional layers enabled. Default search/category state shows every loaded event. Filtering never changes summary/source counts or fetch scope.

Server assembly owns chronological stable ordering (internal\api\daylog\events.go:475-477); frontend appends pages and never independently resorts away source ties. Exact UTC timestamp, source, event id, layer and raw stored enum transitions remain available in details.
Unknown future event types map to Other rather than disappearing; original user place names remain verbatim.

Payload detail rows retain known scalar fields and unknown scalar fallback. Nested objects are currently skipped, not claimed displayed; backend payload guarantees beyond inspected source remain unverified.
Raw SI remains on wire/cache. Summary formatter callbacks and timeline useUnits convert only for display; no legacy unit helpers.
Retained data stays visible on refresh failure/offline; no blanket data gate may remove three sections.
Source statuses and signal-feed transition-only explanation survive; user presence cannot be synthesized. Session summaries and input-cap truncation remain distinct.
No export action is authored by this page; preserve copy link and valid referenced record navigation rather than inventing export capabilities.
